apps.name: DreamPair desktop Demo
apps.short_description:
Customize your own character pair and put them on your desktop!
Custom parts supported! Watch them talk and hang out on your screen, and share your creations with friends! Focus together in Focus Mode! Your pair sits beside you with a focus timer and a to-do list.

apps.name: Drive With Friends Demo
apps.short_description: Friendslop Drive is a chaotic co‑op driving game where one car is shared by multiple players. As one of the top friendslop games, teamwork and rivalry collide on a mysterious island. Can your crew reach the PEAK of madness and escape together? Only the best bros survive the ride!

apps.name: Dude, Trust Me Demo
apps.short_description: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

apps.name: Dumpster Gang Demo
apps.short_description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

apps.name: Dungebra Demo
apps.short_description: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

apps.name: Dust Front RTS Demo
apps.short_description: Dust Front is a classic RTS with 4X/grand strategy elements. In this demo, you will try out the RTS side: lead a triumphant siege of an industrial city. Command strike groups and crush one of two enemy factions.

apps.name: Emissary One Demo
apps.short_description: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

apps.name: Epic Seven Demo
apps.short_description:
PLAY THE ANIMATION! A playable anime in your hands, Epic Seven.
A turn-based Hero collection RPG alive with stunning 2D visuals. Collect unique Heroes in the Seventh World and plan your path to victory through elemental effects and skill combinations.
Challenge Heirs worldwide in World Arena PvP.

apps.name: Epithet Demo
apps.short_description: A PvP duels based Soulslike

apps.name: Eruin Demo
apps.short_description: Wake without a name in a town stripped of its memories. In this demo of Eruin, speak naturally with its inhabitants, talk your way past a guarded gate, and face a witch’s riddles. Your words can open doors.

apps.name: ESCAPE PROTOCOL: Online (Demo)
apps.short_description: In this co-op horror game, escape an unknown realm where reality is shattered and dimensions collide. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly entities, and uncover the hidden saboteur.

apps.name: Escape the Backrooms Bodycam Demo
apps.short_description: Face pure fear inside the endless backrooms. Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM Demo throws you into a hyper-realistic bodycam horror experience where every step, shot, and shadow could mean death in this Demo.

apps.name: Eternal Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: In this swashbuckling survivor-lite, face relentless hordes and ultimate bosses. Embark on a 3-act journey with 5 intrepid heroes. Harvest P.L.A.N.T. power and shatter game designers’ dreams of balance with game-breaking builds.

apps.name: Everfront Demo
apps.short_description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

apps.name: Evil Moon: Unspoken Demo
apps.short_description: Boomer Shooter Metroidvania. Nun with a gun. Because of the Malediction of the Moon, only devoted sisters with vows of silence can move freely in the city of Abbadox. So take up arms, Siléncia, and blast your way through these cobbled and winding streets!

apps.name: Evocation Demo
apps.short_description: Evocation is a card game with unique gameplay, high interactivity, and deep mechanics. It includes a roguelike PvE mode and an online PvP mode without in-app purchases. Draw and maintain your magical circle, freely trade and craft equipment, and purge the heretics along the pilgrimage path.

apps.name: Expedition: Into Darkness Demo
apps.short_description: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE coop extraction looter. Craft weapons, customize gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

apps.name: False Echo Demo
apps.short_description: False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Stelantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.

apps.name: Fame & Fear: Dungeon Architect Demo
apps.short_description: Build the kingdom's most famous dungeon. Kill enough heroes to grow rich. Let enough survive to become legendary.

apps.name: Fame Or Folly Demo
apps.short_description: The outrageous traveling troupe roguelike deckbuilder. Put on shows across the kingdom, push your luck at the risk of upsetting the crowd. Pivot your deck using a variety of cards, banners, and props. Become the king of the festival either solo or in ranked multiplayer!

apps.name: Fangjie:Shattered Altars Demo
apps.short_description: Become an adventurer set on restoring order in a shattered voxel world. This demo covers the opening hours: procedural exploration, class and skill trees, action combat, up to a boss fight against the Stone Guardian.

apps.name: Farmer's Diary Demo
apps.short_description: There is a lot of work to be done on this farm. A long-term adventure awaits you where you can take farming and orcharding to the next level with your friends.

apps.name: FATE PACK Demo
apps.short_description: FATE PACK is a ruthless PvP auto-battler: weapon decay forces you to adapt, and skill choices are permanent. Merge gear, build combos, and prove your mettle against real players!

apps.name: Fate Startrail Demo
apps.short_description: Fate Startrail is a single-player roguelite strategy RPG demo. Launch your character through a field of dice, plan ricochets, roll results, and trigger familiar attacks, healing, and control effects.
developers: 沈阳北境星火科技有限公司
publishers: 沈阳北境星火科技有限公司

apps.name: Feather's Edge Demo
apps.short_description: Dash and slash through an innovative kinetic metroidvania. The Tower of Time awaits – a rich, handcrafted world fractured by the collapse of time. Slice through foes in tough-as-talons bite-sized battles, and master the way of the bird warrior.

apps.name: Federal Cadet Demo
apps.short_description: Federal Cadet is a single-player police simulation and investigation game. Start as a cadet in Pinewood, patrol the town, question witnesses and suspects, analyze evidence, and rise through the department ranks.

apps.name: Fire Isle Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy, turn-based strategy party-game for 1–4 players where everyone moves at once. Spread fire across a new hex island every match, block rivals, set traps and race for Wisps, the key to victory. Play online with friends or solo against bots.

apps.name: Firefighters Code Red Demo
apps.short_description: When fear takes over, your mission begins: in Firefighters Code Red you battle flames, smoke, and the clock!

apps.name: Firewall Demo
apps.short_description: Become a hacker building cyber defense systems in this retro-futuristic deep strategy tower defense game. Build your firewall using limited compute power and sector space, connect mods, fight along your defenses running programs and expand to new sectors to protect the Grid from ever-growing chaos.

apps.name: Fleshgrinder Demo
apps.short_description:
An isometric tactical horror RPG.
Fleshgrinder is a virus that causes an extinction-level event, harvesting DNA samples and trying to digitally accelerate evolution in the so-called Genesis Chamber after taking over the minds of the augmented population.

apps.name: Food Devils Demo
apps.short_description: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Tactics-RPG Roguelite.

apps.name: Football Card Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: Open your own football card shop! Stock up, rip packs, set your prices, and hunt holo, autograph, and serial-numbered cards. Build an all-star lineup, conquer the card leagues, and win the World Championship!

apps.name: FOURSAVENT Demo
apps.short_description: Two Modes, CHAOS or Story Mode. Explore different universes and time eras, from cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, each with its own story and gameplay mechanics—or jump into CHAOS Mode for fast-paced fun with friends and climb the ranks.

apps.name: Fragment Echoes Demo
apps.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi hack-and-slash roguelike where you wield four weapons, chain fluid air and ground combos, and evolve your combat style with randomized Echo abilities.

apps.name: Frog Knight Demo
apps.short_description: A brave little frog and his talking sword climb a cursed well in this precision platformer. Jump, bounce, and master your timing to save the world. No checkpoints. No shortcuts. Just one long climb... or fall.

apps.name: Frogball Demo
apps.short_description: Classic 90's GameBoy style Pinball... this time with frogs! Compete against your friends and the world for the highest scores on 8 unique, interlinked pinball tables. It's fast, fun and impossible to put down!

apps.name: Frostward Demo
apps.short_description: Frostward is a turn-based 4X survival strategy game set on a frozen hex world, where you plan districts, work toward monumental Wonders, command armies in battle, and decide whether humanity will endure, escape, or restore warmth to the world.

apps.name: Funeral Flowers Lament: Helena Demo
apps.short_description:
A small-squad tactical RPG featuring high-speed battles and gameplay built around fast-paced combat.
With the Reverse Weapon Triangle system and 13–15 character roster, enjoy strategic battles where every ally matters.
【Playable up to Chapter 6・Save Data Transfer Supported】

apps.name: Futa Slug EX Demo
apps.short_description: NSFW roguelike with male/female player character creation, meta-progression, 55 collectible girls, and 9 epic boss battles! Step into the shoes of the Captain and dominate your lustful rivals. Supports all genitalia variations: hermaphrodite, male genitalia only, and female genitalia only.

apps.name: GameJam 水群模拟器 Demo
apps.short_description: A simulation game that immerses you in the real group chat dynamics of indie developers during a 21-day game jam.

apps.name: GemSlasher Demo
apps.short_description:
GemSlasher is an action roguelite where every attack is built from gems.
Combine Main Gems with Support Gems, merge duplicate gems to increase their star level, and create powerful builds capable of tearing through relentless waves of monsters.

apps.name: Generation Ship Demo
apps.short_description: You will each be in charge of expanding your spaceship by constructing different Sector cards and building several Tech and Expedition cards on top. Generate and spend Supplies effectively to optimize your sectors and bid on exciting expeditions to obtain the most victory points and win.

apps.name: Ghost Hunting Journal Demo
apps.short_description: Ghost Hunting Journal is an anime-style narrative adventure game. The duo partners of self-proclaimed "Spirit Agent" accept various supernatural commissions, use a full set of ghost-hunting techniques to tackle urban myths caused by lingering ghosts in the city of Riverrun.

apps.name: Ghost in the SQL Data Demo
apps.short_description: Somebody reported the fire fourteen minutes before it started. Prove it in real SQL. Learn the language from your first line, question a live evidence database, and let the records name the culprit for you.

apps.name: Ghost Receipt Demo
apps.short_description: Run a cyberpunk grocery store and pawn shop in a neon-soaked city. Buy, sell, negotiate deals, investigate mysterious items, and piece together customer stories through the items they bring, the secrets they hide, and the risks you choose to take.

apps.name: Go Next! Demo
apps.short_description: Grow exponentially stronger as you survive hordes of monsters across 9 different worlds. Gather resources, level up, build your skill tree, and parkour your way out of chaos!

apps.name: GoGeez Demo
apps.short_description: GoGeez is a cozy idle incremental where cute chibi creatures stack into a self-growing engine of synergy, progression, and quiet obsession. Build, break, and rebuild - until the power goes out. You're alone in your room. Or are you?

apps.name: Golf-Like Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of a golf roguelike where the ball never stops. Tee off onto a road over the sea that sinks behind you, steer through the air, shoot down the spiked escorts hunting you and face the Kraken. Pick your route through portals, sports arenas and hidden caves.

apps.name: GOLUBI Demo
apps.short_description: An atmospheric, surreal story-driven adventure. Explore strange rooms, houses, and streets, meet unusual characters, and solve puzzles. Observe, listen, and piece together the story from fragments, because the world of GOLUBI won’t explain anything

apps.name: Grass Demo
apps.short_description: Grab your tools and team up in a cozy co-op or solo lawn care simulator focused on smooth, satisfying teamwork. Mow, trim, water, burn, and clean up sprawling properties as you improve the neighborhood and climb the mower app rankings.

apps.name: Greed Forest Demo
apps.short_description:
A real-time roguelite tower defense game about extracting the riches of the forest.
Lure creatures to your emitter and mow them down with towers and spells. Build freely, shape your maze, and choose spells that transform how you play.

apps.name: Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight Demo
apps.short_description: Combine cards into powerful spells in this roguelite deckbuilder. Build your strategy around four elements, read enemy intentions in turn-based battles, and grow stronger between runs as Ray climbs the Tower of Starlight to find her missing mother.

apps.name: GROWTH EXPERIMENT Demo
apps.short_description:
"In a certain apartment room, 'I' began a life with 'Chloe,' who had lost intelligence and memory. 
By navigating between the present and the past, it becomes clear what happened to the deteriorated 'Chloe.' Whether you interpret the ending as a happy one is entirely up to you."

apps.name: Guildrun Demo
apps.short_description: A PvE roguelike autobattler with no timers, no queue and no PvP. Draft a guild, rank heroes from C to S and stack 300+ relics into builds that one-shot bosses. Climb 8 difficulties and the Endless leaderboards. Start small, become unstoppable.

apps.name: Hack You Demo
apps.short_description: Desktop hacking and social engineering in a moral thriller. Write viruses, hide them in game builds, crack other people's PCs — to get to the former friend who stole your life and built a new success on its ruins.

apps.name: Hanabi Craft Demo
apps.short_description:
Craft firework shells and launch your own creations into the night sky in this 3D fireworks crafting game.
Enjoy a wide range of crafting tools and realistic visuals inspired by real fireworks. 
Light up the night sky with your original fireworks and build your own collection.

apps.name: HANDS OVER Demo
apps.short_description: Try HANDS OVER in this demo: a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends and try to stay at the table until the end.

apps.name: Haphazard Angel Demo
apps.short_description: Grab a wing and join the chaos! In this co-op multiplayer madness, each player controls an Angel's wing. Collect orbs, outsmart your friends, and keep the balance—or don't. Who needs teamwork when you’ve got wings and questionable decisions?

apps.name: HARMA Demo
apps.short_description: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

apps.name: HAZPIT Demo
apps.short_description: A top-down survival game where you work your way down zombie-infested high-rises, floor by floor from the roof. Lower floors mean more radiation and zombies, but better loot. Stay undetected when you can, and use what you bring back to repair your bunker and recruit survivors. Single-player only.

apps.name: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator Demo
Heavy Mental: A Co-op Action Roguelite Demo
apps.short_description: Experience 3D Run 'n Gun chaos! Fight on foot as a Cyborg or lead an Iron Snake tank with modular trailers. Blast through dual-wielding grandmas and teleporting ninjas to conquer 5 massive fortresses. Upgrade with power cards in this high-octane Co-op Action Roguelite. Join the siege!

apps.name: Hell Clock Demo
apps.short_description: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

apps.name: Helrift Demo
apps.short_description: Experience old-school MMORPG intensity in Helrift, where two towns clash. Battle for dominance in server-wide events, master a classless stat and skill-based progression system, and engage in high-stakes open-world PvP. Forge your path through crafting, trading, and tactical combat.

apps.name: Hemlon the Grey Demo
apps.short_description: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

apps.name: Hexograph Demo
apps.short_description: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.

apps.name: Hit The Beer Demo
apps.short_description: Hit The Beer is a lightweight idle collection game that stays in the corner of your desktop. Your anonymous keyboard rhythm brews different beers without recording what you type, attracting customers with unique tastes to come and sample them.

apps.name: HitTube Demo
apps.short_description: HitTube is a 1-4 player horror streamer shooter. The zombie apocalypse is here and now you're a streamer who kills live for donations. Your weapon is a minigun and your minigun is your best friend!

apps.name: HOMUNCAT Demo
apps.short_description: HomunCat: and the Blind Mansion is a co-op horror game where you play as plush cats and try to escape a mysterious mansion. Shout voice commands like “MEOW!” and “KICK!” to play, but beware of monsters that react to sound. Collect mana and work together to escape!

apps.name: Hot Meals Fast Wheels Demo
apps.short_description: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

apps.name: Hungry Ghosts Demo
apps.short_description: Hungry Ghosts is a wild tower defense roguelike where you exorcise hungry ghosts with magical desserts and drinks! Play as a fearless witch and her various companions with unique powers, upgrade your dishes, and unleash powerful synergies to survive haunted waves and defeat bosses.

apps.name: Hunter's Hand Demo
apps.short_description: A tactical turn-based roguelike deckbuilder set in a cursed world. Build your deck, escalate Threat, and face a powerful Ancient in this playable opening chapter of Hunter’s Hand.

apps.name: I Buried Steve Demo
apps.short_description: Eight players build a lethal beach obstacle course, then all eight have to survive it. Think Ultimate Chicken Horse crossed with Fall Guys, with axes, artillery and a Sharknado. Draft the traps, rig the sand, then run for your life as the water rises.

apps.name: Idle Archery Demo
apps.short_description: In Idle Archery, destroy targets to earn money, hire archers and stack upgrades to multiply your income.

apps.name: If Red Then Stop Demo
apps.short_description: Program traffic lights, barriers, and more to solve your city’s traffic problems! Improve your coding skills by learning to control time-dependent processes with realistic state machines.

apps.name: Ignite the Depths Demo
apps.short_description: Ignite the Depths is an atmospheric dark-fantasy PvE dungeon crawler set within a sprawling, hand-crafted labyrinth. Descend into the darkness alone or unite with up to 4 players in a co-op adventure. Will you conquer the Abyss?

apps.name: INANIMA Demo
apps.short_description: A survival horror game set in the isolated facilities of a strange corporation. Search for limited supplies, and fight terrifying creatures to reveal the truth behind the Lazarus project. Be part of something that will change the future of humanity.

apps.name: Island Raiders Demo
apps.short_description: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

apps.name: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival Demo
apps.short_description: Survive, build, and grow your own life in Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival Demo. Explore dangerous wilderness, gather resources, farm, craft equipment, and create a safe haven deep in the wild in this Demo.

apps.name: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Step into the shoes of an electronics technician and repair damaged devices: receivers, phones, speakers, and more. Solder, diagnose, replace components, earn money, and grow your workshop!

apps.name: I’m a Wizard, But I Dig Demo
apps.short_description: Shorten your journey to the castle by digging a tunnel through the mountain. Use magic and craft: swing your pickaxe, cast spells, blow up obstacles, and light your path with glowing slimes. Trade resources with the Goose, unlock new tools, and uncover the mountain's secrets.

apps.name: Joker's Last Call Demo
apps.short_description: A dark casino roguelike based on One Card, a fast and aggressive Korean card game rarely seen outside Korea. Stack attacks, counter two rivals, build rule-bending relic combinations, and reverse a deadly chain with a single Joker.

apps.name: JUST PRESS SPACE Demo
apps.short_description: JUST PRESS SPACE is a brutal pixel-art souls-like, roguelite where one button controls everything.

apps.name: just volleyball Demo
apps.short_description: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with simple controls and deep player expression. take on others in this limited time demo in 2v2s, 4v4s, and 6v6!

apps.name: Kaiju Princess: Super Survivor Showdown Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a phantasmic realm! Pulverize your enemies! Don't die! Ah... But don't forget to find a way out! Choose from a variety of weapons, skills, and items to complement your character's traits and customize the optimal combat style for survival. Get ready for a fast-paced roguelike survival game!

apps.name: Kazfall Demo
apps.short_description:
Kazfall is a single-player roguelite dungeon crawler built on 25-minute runs. 
Fight with stamina and timed blocks, discover NPCs who sell upgrades and gear, and reach the boss before time runs out. 
Even failed runs make you stronger for the next descent.

apps.name: Keelblade Demo
apps.short_description: Sail across a fantasy world in your own pirate ship. Master souls-like combat and powerful magic to hunt deadly bosses. Discover new islands and loot them for hidden treasures to craft upgrades for both you and your ship. (1-6 Players)

apps.name: KickTheDungeon Demo
apps.short_description: Kick the Dungeon is a card-based tactical roguelike game based on the SRD 5.1 rules. Assemble a unique party, tailor your own build, and enjoy the thrill of combat. Use cards to cast familiar spells like Fireball and Magic Missile — every run offers a different experience.

apps.name: Last Look along Woodward Boulevard Demo
apps.short_description: An esotreric horror puzzle adventure, where your thoughts and mood affect the environment around you.

apps.name: Last Store on Earth Demo
apps.short_description: You run the last store in a ruined world, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op. Clean and restore your shop, get the generator running, restock the shelves, and open your doors to the survivors who still come knocking. A survival and shopkeeping sim where every customer has a story.

apps.name: Legendum Demo
apps.short_description: Start as a nobody and become a legend before old age claims you in this incremental RPG. Fight hordes in idle combat, plan your days, and train your skills. Grow your soul and unravel a dark plot across generations. Every life reshapes the world, and one will finish what the rest began.

apps.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It. Demo
apps.short_description: Treasure chests, foes, ore, or materials—each adventurer follows their own compulsion. Set a destination to guide their automatic movement, weigh the risks of shortcuts and detours, and grow through skills combining powerful abilities with troublesome quirks in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

apps.name: Little Warrior Demo
apps.short_description: The Tiny Warrior demo features early-game content, allowing players to experience the core combat, character progression, and level-based gameplay. Demo content may differ from the final release.

apps.name: Loftia Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

apps.name: Logisticats Demo
apps.short_description: Move to a floating island and start a new life alongside a colony of cats with unique personalities! In this cozy business sim, you'll help your cats to plant crops and build buildings before taking to the skies in your airship to lead your feline crew in search of treasure and adventure!

apps.name: Long Trip Demo
apps.short_description: Long Trip is an action role-playing VR game set in a fantasy world where you can ride mounts, recruit warriors, tame pets, hunt, gather, cook, craft weapons, obtain magic abilities, and even summon ancient mechs or dragons to aid you in battles against bosses.

apps.name: Lost Liminal Demo
apps.short_description: "Descend into liminal space—evade lurking horrors, solve cryptic puzzles, and use your camera to preserve the memories you leave behind in this eerie world. Switch to night vision to uncover hidden clues and trace what's amiss. This first-person indie horror will keep you guessing at every turn."

apps.name: Love in the Med Pit Demo
apps.short_description: Sort surgical trays, stock supply drawers and fall for Dr. Shack Abassy, a gruff ER veteran with a soft spot for his emerald-eyed cat. Love in the Med Pit is a cozy medical sorting romance drawn like a 1950s hospital manual. No timers, no rush. Everything has its place.

apps.name: Lust of the Dead Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the demo of the first chapter of Lust of the Dead, a first-person survival horror set in St. Erebus Hospital, where desire bacame infection. Explore its abandoned halls, uncover the secrets of Eros-9, solve puzzles, manage scarce resources, and survive the horrors within.

apps.name: Lust Shelter Demo
apps.short_description: Apocalypse survival meets incremental adventure. By day, scavenge the wasteland and fight mutated beasts. By night, return to your shelter and have some fun with the girls. The world outside is brutal, but your shelter is pure bliss.

apps.name: Magical Girl Demo
apps.short_description: Try a pixel-art magical-girl action adventure. Experience the opening chapter, three fighting styles and four combat areas. Between battles, attend school, talk with classmates and join activities. Choose how to spend each day in the city.

apps.name: Mana Boom Demo
apps.short_description: Magic meets physics, and the world is yours to mess with! Battle or race with up to 8 players in real time. Lob spells with your choice of elements and projectile behaviors, swing on ropes, and destroy or create terrain. Win your own way. Play dirty, but don't let it backfire!

apps.name: Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter Demo
Matelotes Demo
apps.short_description: The Royal Hen has disappeared! Lead a group of enthusiastic but incompetent female sailors on a quest for glory, riches, and—as fate would have it—a chicken. Explore islands, resolve political crises, and upgrade your ship in this narrative-driven adventure inspired by RPGs.

apps.name: MayDay MayDie Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person social deduction game on a luxury plane, featuring real-time action and betrayal for up to 8 players. Passengers rush to complete tasks and survive violent turbulence to land the airliner, while hidden Hijackers sabotage it to force a crash. No voting, just pure paranoia.

apps.name: Meltdown Crew Demo
apps.short_description: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.

apps.name: Mercy Incore Demo
apps.short_description:
Solo indie character-action. You are a medieval knight in a techno-dimension.
Become a jet-boosted vampire to survive. Follow a full-metal spaniel to escape

apps.name: Mewtations: Dogma Demo
apps.short_description: Build a cat colony on a cluttered board of cards. Craft, farm and gear up your crew, send them on roguelite expeditions with automatic battles, and stand up to Boss Huohuo's dog mafia, before the next tax note comes due.

apps.name: Midnight Horde Demo
apps.short_description: Midnight Horde is a gothic horror parkour action game with rogue-lite elements where you battle thousands of enemies. Upgrade weapons, fortify castles and towns to keep darkness at bay.

apps.name: Midnight Souls Demo
apps.short_description: Dive into the secrets of the quiet hamlet of Camomile Peaks! A romantic trip to meet your online crush spirals into a mystical adventure: epic battles, bizarre allies, and dark humor. Win her heart, solve the mysteries, and protect your cat, Charlie!

apps.name: Mining Merchant Demo
apps.short_description: Your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and it’s your job to bring it back to life! Mine precious ore, smelt it into shiny jewelry, add rare gemstones and sell to every customer who walks in. Mine by day, sell by night, solo or in co-op, and become a successful merchant!

apps.name: Mom! I'm gonna be a black hole when I grow up! Demo
Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040 Demo
apps.short_description: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

apps.name: Mortuus Demo
apps.short_description: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.

apps.name: Motel Owner Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own motel in Motel Owner Simulator Demo. Design rooms, attract guests, expand your property, and grow from a small roadside stop into a thriving hospitality empire in this Demo.

apps.name: Music Manager Demo
apps.short_description:
This is the demo version of Music Manager. The demo lets you play for 18 in-game months.



Demo save compatibility with the full game is planned where possible but cannot be guaranteed while the game is still in development. Major updates may make some demo saves incompatible with the full release.

apps.name: Mutter Demo
apps.short_description: In the midst of war, a far more personal horror takes root at home. Your mother is becoming a monster. Survive, uncover the truth, and navigate a heartbreaking bond in this unique stop-motion narrative horror adventure.

apps.name: My Oshi Uses Too Much Slang! Demo
apps.short_description: Will your comment get picked up by your oshi? In "My Oshi Uses Too Much Slang!", you join the stream of a rookie VTuber who calls herself seiso but whose emotions spill right out. Read the room, drop the right slang, and she'll call your name. Comment fearlessly and carry your oshi to 1M subs!

apps.name: My Snake Likes Apples Demo
apps.short_description: A short, minimalist incremental game about raising a foolish snake and helping it go the distance.

apps.name: Never Be Alone Demo
apps.short_description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

apps.name: Never Wither Demo
apps.short_description: Experience unprecedented creature collection gameplay—Transform into almost any creature you see! Collect and raise fantastical creatures, and command them to farm, build, and craft. In this open world survival crafting game, Establish your settlement, become the last hope against the Corruption.

apps.name: Next Station is... Demo
apps.short_description: You operate the final subway train of the night. Inspect each platform, watch the passengers, and decide whether to open the doors or leave the station behind. Make the wrong choice, and something may board with them.

apps.name: Night Machine Demo
apps.short_description: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

apps.name: Night Plane Demo
apps.short_description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

apps.name: Night Portable Demo
apps.short_description: A free demo of Night Portable, a night-shift survival horror set in a 2000s secondhand game store. Clean, restock, and survive until 6 AM. Play three retro handheld games to earn items for the 3D store. The threat keeps moving while you play.

apps.name: Nighthold Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the first hours of Nighthold in this demo. Build shelters, interact with survivors, explore the alien world, and fight the Rot and raiders to survive the night in this Sandbox RPG.

apps.name: No Body No Problem! Demo
apps.short_description: Get your first taste of chaos in No Body, No Problem! Demo. One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, and try to get away with the perfect crime before the police uncover the truth.

apps.name: No Prospects Demo
apps.short_description: Build railways deep into monster-infested caves in this online co-op horror game. Work together to mine valuable ore, fill your minecart, and upgrade your equipment as you venture into increasingly dangerous depths.

apps.name: Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator Demo
Note Bounce – Sheet Music Game & Video Creator Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo: tap bouncing balls on real sheet music across 7 songs, import your own MIDI files, and render 720p videos. The full game unlocks 30+ songs and watermark-free 4K rendering.

apps.name: Novalex Project Zero Demo
apps.short_description: Build a car empire from a single garage. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, price sharp, and outsell 30 AI rivals — a turn-based automaker tycoon spanning decades. Out-engineer the competition or go bankrupt trying.

apps.name: Noyan: Club Chairman Demo
apps.short_description: In Noyan: Club Chairman, you’re the president, not the manager. Leave tactics to the coach; your job is to manage finances, lock down sponsors, and win over the fans. Remember: matches are played on the pitch, but the club’s future is won in the presidential office!

apps.name: Of Dice and Minions Demo
apps.short_description: Roll five dice and turn them into an army. Hold, reroll, chase a poker hand, then watch your minions fight on their own. Free demo: the tutorial and the first 20 dungeon floors, two bosses included.

apps.name: On Any Journey Demo
apps.short_description: Designed exclusively for two players, < On Any Journey > is a co-op adventure packed with varied gameplay challenges that call for teamwork, coordination and a healthy dose of sabotage.

apps.name: On the Rocks Demo
apps.short_description: Run a bar in a toxic wasteland, solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Scavenge the wasteland, brew with what you find, and serve whoever comes through your doors. In a world gone to ruin, the last bar standing is yours to run together.

apps.name: One More Tower Demo
apps.short_description: One More Tower is a horde survival TD set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer an unexplored forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive?

apps.name: ORMOD: Directive Demo
apps.short_description:
Shape your own survival experience in an infinite open-world sandbox. 
Customize world difficulty, rules, and playstyle. 
Play solo, co-op, or on 24/7 MMO-style servers across PvP, PvE, Hardcore, or Creative modes as you build, automate, fight, and survive.
The choice is yours.

apps.name: Outcast Tales Demo
apps.short_description: Assemble a squad of characters with robust personalities and abilities, and their relationships unfold. Engage in deep tactical battles, make tough decisions, and choose your own adventures - write an Outcast Tale that’s unique to you!

apps.name: Overwrite Conflict Demo
apps.short_description: Shape placement meets turn-based roguelike deckbuilding. Rotate and deploy protocols to contest cells and limit rivals. Chain effects within limited turns to raise your tactical score and turn a lead into damage. Collect protocols, components and supplies on random routes to build around your mech.

apps.name: Pack or Die Demo
apps.short_description: Manage your inventory case in a classic style as your character automatically advances through a post-apocalyptic world, fighting hordes of zombies with weapons and ammo you strategically organize.

apps.name: PAPER STRIKE Demo
apps.short_description: Discover Arin in this solo demo of Paper Strike. Face waves of enemies, draw runes with your mouse to cast spells and find the right moment to finish your drawing. The full 3v3 party arena game is in development.

apps.name: Paraxima Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to E.S.C. As a team of 1-3, your job is to respond to paranormal outbreaks of The Static. Investigate either as a Field Agent or an Operator. Establish the chain of events with evidence to identify the Entity. Follow the protocol to seal it.

apps.name: Patient Zero: Plague Idle Demo
apps.short_description: In the demo version of Patient Zero: Plague Idle, you can start with any of the four pathogen types and evolve it to challenge humanity. Four pathogens, global map, and strategic choices - the epidemic begins here.

apps.name: Pawnshop Together Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own pawn shop solo or with up to 3 friends! Buy, negotiate, inspect, repair, and sell items to build your business and find new ways to make money around town.

apps.name: Pay or Die: Cartel Simulator Demo
PeeVPee Demo
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

apps.name: Pelikeeper Demo
apps.short_description: In this demo of Pelikeeper, you will defend fallen stars from an onslaught of shadow creatures, strategize with unique animal towers, and upgrade your lighthouse community as you adventure through the first season and get an introduction to this cosmic adventure.

apps.name: Phroller - Free Version
apps.short_description: The next generation touchscreen native, controller tested, battery efficient, cross-platform with tablets and mobile, offline enabled, 2.5/3D VTT, Dice Roller and RPG Companion! Featuring a massive library of free assets and models.

apps.name: Pig Up Demo
apps.short_description: Pig Up is a third-person 3D platform adventure game. Control the piglet to climb floating platforms, travel through fantastic worlds to find lost companions and uncover the truth hidden behind the temporal chaos.

apps.name: PITH Demo
apps.short_description: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

apps.name: Plink Lab Demo
apps.short_description: A satisfying active plinko incremental where you drop and bounce fantastic creatures (tiny humans for starters) to clear pegs and earn a trillion $! Wacky balls, massive tech tree, total physics-based chaos, and a very chatty goblin shop owner.

apps.name: Plucked Demo
apps.short_description: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

apps.name: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16 Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your personality shapes the experience. Answer unsettling questions, endure disturbing trials, and survive an evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave.

apps.name: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor Demo
apps.short_description: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a turn-based party RPG set in the Forgotten Realms. Build a band of heroes, descend into the haunted elven ruins of Myth Drannor, and use tactical positioning, spellcraft and steel to stop a dracolich from corrupting the realm.

apps.name: Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling Demo
apps.short_description: Manage heavy machinery, load cargo, operate cranes and tugboats, and keep the harbor running smoothly in Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling Demo. Experience realistic port operations across dynamic day and night conditions ⚓

apps.name: Portal way Demo
apps.short_description: Portal way is a spatial puzzle about finding a path through portals.

apps.name: Project Legend Demo
apps.short_description: Create a young prospect and shape one footballer’s career across three complete seasons. Develop your player, experience simulation-driven matches and live highlights, navigate contracts and transfers, and make decisions that shape your future in Project Legend.

apps.name: PROJECT M.E.D.S. Demo
apps.short_description: The body is under attack. Hordes of infectious germs are spreading rapidly, overwhelming its natural defenses. As the last line of defense, you'll battle through massive waves of pathogens, unlock powerful medical weapons, and fight to keep your host alive.

apps.name: Project MAGNUM Demo
apps.short_description: Take control of the M1A5 MAGNUM. Fight mechs, drones, robots, and enemy tanks across ruined cities, frozen wastelands, and abandoned battlefields. Explore a hostile world and customize your tank with a powerful arsenal of weapons and upgrades as you uncover the secrets buried beneath the ruins.

apps.name: Pyramid Wars Demo
apps.short_description: Pyramid Wars is a fast, top-down pixel-art RTS. Fight massive RTS battles against an overwhelming enemy. Cast abilities and automate your base. Buy boosterpacks to get legendary units and increase your army even further.

apps.name: RAID VR Demo
apps.short_description: A co-op VR sci-fi shooter where you inspect interstellar cargo ships, hunt smugglers, and raid hostile spacecraft. Scan trucks, board enemy ships, upgrade outrageous weapons, and choose between protocol or profit in solo or 2-player co-op action (4 players planned in full release).

apps.name: Rally Point Demo
apps.short_description: A real-time auto-battler with a roguelite campaign. Draft a squad of hero, mech and support cards, then push through a galaxy of hour-long runs. Deploy down open lanes, take the control points, break the enemy base - and never micro a single unit.

apps.name: Real Car Market Simulator Together Demo
ReBlade: The Death Spiral Demo
apps.short_description: You are a condemned Synthetic, marked for destruction and trapped in endless resets. In a cyberpunk world inspired by Chinese mythology, harness weapons, chips, and augments to cut through mechanical creatures. Each run brings you closer to breaking the cycle and unravelling the truth.

apps.name: Rechained Demo
apps.short_description: A demo covering the opening of RE:CHAINED. A grid tactical RPG with deckbuilding: choose where to stand, choose what to play. In this demo you cross the threshold of the Abyss and take three Revenants as allies.

apps.name: Rekindled Trails Demo
apps.short_description: Gather and Sell faraway goods to rebuild ruined towns and bring back light to a dark world in this cozy adventure game. With the help of your fire companion, fish, pull and mine natural resources in Aurteris to unite the people of this strange yet fantastic world!

apps.name: Remains on the bus Demo
apps.short_description: Every passenger could be a shapeshifter. You are a bus driver who must let ordinary passengers board while identifying and kicking out shapeshifters hiding among them.

apps.name: Remedy of Balance Demo
apps.short_description: A farming sim with a potion-crafting twist. Craft and treat patients in Palmia. Climb the ranks to become Guildmaster of the Alchemist Guild. Along with other activities like farming, animal handling, building relationships, and more.

apps.name: Remote Control Demo
apps.short_description: Remote-control human proxies to explore a derelict spaceship. Type your commands, manage risk and decide how disposable a life really is.

apps.name: Rescue Ops Demo
apps.short_description: Become a wildland firefighter and battle raging wildfires around the world. Play solo or in co-op to rescue civilians, operate specialized vehicles, and outsmart fast-spreading, dynamic fires.

apps.name: Reshine Demo
apps.short_description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

apps.name: Resurface Demo
apps.short_description: Escape the ocean depths in this casual incremental mining game. Mine, upgrade, and explore as your strength grows to crazy proportions, but don’t run out of oxygen!

apps.name: Retro Coder 2000 Demo
apps.short_description: March 1991. Your brother is gone, leaving his room and a 90s PC that still dials in. Play the opening chapter: get online, take coding jobs, answer the mail and upgrade the machine, in VR or on desktop. Your demo career carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Riddled Together Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person online co-op puzzle game where communication is the only way to solve puzzles and escape.

apps.name: Rideshare "Stimulator" Demo
apps.short_description: Build your rideshare business while navigating real-world traffic, managing your vehicle, and transporting a wide range of unique passengers. Master the streets, keep your car in shape, and deliver every ride, no matter how strange it gets.

apps.name: Rift Raiders Demo
apps.short_description: Tear open the rifts, raid them for everything, and haul your spoils home to rebuild. Grid combat, push-your-luck runs, and a kingdom that grows stronger every time you fall.

apps.name: Rig the Casino Demo
apps.short_description:
The house always wins. So stop playing fair — RIG IT.

ROGUELIKE LUCK-ENGINE BUILDER where you GAMBLE, CHOOSE UPGRADES, and RIG THE CASINO.

apps.name: Rise From Ashes Demo
apps.short_description: Demo for <Rise From Ashes>, a tactical survivors-like where your build, not your luck, decides the run: merge Scrolls, bind Sigils, and complete synergies as you climb the Spire. Every run will be a volume of a comic, which your adventure draws each page.

apps.name: Road Truckers: New Beginning Demo
apps.short_description: Start your trucking sim adventure in a massive demo without playtime limits. Explore the full countryside map in a customizable truck. Do transport jobs, meet people, and start expanding the business on your journey to fortune and greatness.

apps.name: ROCKBEASTS Demo
apps.short_description: A darkly funny narrative RPG where you manage a 90s grunge band from garage obscurity to stadium glory. Book gigs, wrangle egos and navigate a cutthroat music industry. Every choice shapes your band’s story and your own. Make it big without selling out.

apps.name: Roguestorm Beats Demo
apps.short_description: A bullet hell where the enemy is silence and your weapon is the jam you write. The music rests muted the music and left the notes to turn wild; capture their energy and apply it to your beat. Then use it to attack the silence and bring back the beat.

apps.name: Rookie Raiders Demo
apps.short_description: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

apps.name: Rottenlands Demo
apps.short_description: Rottenlands is a tower defense deckbuilder where you build a deck of units, towers, and abilities to hold back waves of Mold-corrupted enemies and protect the kingdom.

apps.name: Rulehouse Demo
apps.short_description: Think you know chess? Want to play a demo? Rulehouse Demo is a pawn chess narrative adventure where every stage rewrites the game. Travel the globe and beyond, master an ever-changing board where new pieces, twisted variants, and cunning opponents keep you guessing from first move to last.

apps.name: Runecast Demo
apps.short_description: Free RUNECAST demo: 15 waves on Easy, from Act 1 to the Web Queen's lair. Cast runes, summon heroes, choose promotions, and prepare your team with the Forge, equipment, and merchant's tent before each battle.

apps.name: Rustmourne Demo
apps.short_description: Demo for Rustmourne, a sci-fi survival horror game with detailed, VR-designed interactions. Traverse the corridors of an ancient, derelict structure and face the tortured beings within: hide, run, or cut off their limbs to survive. Will you understand the purpose of your awakening and get out alive?

apps.name: Samota Demo
apps.short_description: Samota is a Solitaire roguelike deckbuilder. You don't draw cards but instead arrange a pile of cards so it will create huge synergy. Find a bunch of unique effects, buffs, modifiers, relics and uncover the secret this game hides! All of it so that the number goes big and bigger!

apps.name: Saraab: Beyond The Veil Demo
apps.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel about healing, where saving your brother means facing your own demons. Elham’s search pulls her through visions and entities rooted in Arabian folklore, and family secrets that should have stayed buried.

apps.name: Scandinavian Cottage Survival Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Build and customize your dream Scandinavian cottage in this demo, live off the land, and experience peaceful Nordic countryside life through crafting, fishing, hunting, and exploration in a relaxing open-world survival adventure.

apps.name: Scope Creep: The Board Game Demo
Seabun Demo
apps.short_description: Seabun is an incremental 2D survivor-like with creature collection elements, where you play a scientist bunny diving deeper and deeper to find the source of the sea's corruption. Haul your loot home between dives, grow your lab, and raise the fish you rescue into rideable mounts.

apps.name: SEC//SIM — セキュリティエンジニア・シミュレーション Demo
apps.short_description: At 1 a.m., stand watch as a defensive AI in a SOC. Play SEC//SIM's first three nights and an exclusive fourth, Two Sounds. Check signals, trace hosts and keys, earn human approval, then strike at once. Can you spot the quiet move behind a ransomware countdown? Four nights lead into the full story.

apps.name: Second Stone Demo
apps.short_description: Second Stone is a colorful Action RPG built around two fully playable parallel worlds. Play as Shiren, a young treasure hunter who can cross between the vibrant Light World and its sinister mirror, the Shrouded World. Master fast-paced combat and forge your path to power with elemental Manastones.

apps.name: Seres Universalis:Three Kingdoms Demo
apps.short_description: Return to the Three Kingdoms period. On the grand strategic tactical battlefield, use terrain for defense setup and resource allocation to shift the battle situation. Control the war via hexagonal grid movement and tactical ability activation, and unify the realm.

apps.name: Shadows of the Dungeon Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person tactical dungeon crawler inspired by 1990s classics. Explore two full levels, choose from 9 playable species and all 12 classes, and experience tactical combat, spells, abilities and dice-driven adventuring.

apps.name: Shit-Stealing Gnomes Demo
apps.short_description: Co-op adventure in which you play as little gnomes robbing houses. Be stealthy and steal the dirtiest things you can find.

apps.name: shlack! Demo
apps.short_description: Shlack! is a top-down roguelite where you play as an artist trapped inside their own magazine. Survive against your own characters and drawings.

apps.name: ShootyCraft Demo
apps.short_description: Massive space battles with base building, crafting, automation, and destructible environments. Fight as a team or take on everyone in a free-for-all arena. Play online, single-player, or cooperative with friends.

apps.name: Silicone Heart Demo
apps.short_description: Build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside in this cozy farming and automation adventure.

apps.name: Sirens Demo
apps.short_description: The pre-alpha demo features a section of the first level of the game- Nordic Island.

apps.name: Sisyphus Inc. Demo
apps.short_description:
(The demo contains the 8 first levels of Sisyphus inc.)
Train Imps to push Jerry the Boulder, speak with various inhabitant of the Underworld, and resist the unpleased gods to free Sisyphus from his eternal punishment in a short incremental et narrative game.

apps.name: SKEW Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person atmospheric exploration game set in dreamlike liminal spaces, with no monsters, combat, or jump scares.

apps.name: Sky Pirates Demo
apps.short_description: Set sail with your friends aboard a flying pirate ship! Explore mysterious islands, recover treasures, and survive the dangers of the skies in this co-op adventure where every expedition can quickly descend into chaos.

apps.name: Sling or Spin: Miss and Done? Demo
apps.short_description:
One ball. One slot machine. Seven elements. Build your chaos.
Fire the core ball, break elemental orbs, and fill the reels. Hit the right lines, push your score—before time's up.
With 40+ relics and 40+ skills to combine, your way. Just remember—the more you risk, the wilder the spin.

apps.name: Slot Crawler Demo
apps.short_description: Explore. Kill. Loot. Die. Feed your hard-earned tokens to a slot machine with questionable intentions, then unlock new ways to make terrible decisions on the next run. Slot Crawler is a top-down action roguelike with procedural maps, chaotic builds, and combinations that definitely should not work.

apps.name: Sort Memes Together Demo
apps.short_description: A meme store has exploded! Grab, stack and throw 80 meme products with up to 3 friends in online co-op, sort every cat loaf, stonks bust and pet rock onto the right shelf, and turn total brainrot chaos into the tidiest meme shop on the internet.

apps.name: Sort On The Ball Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy game about opening tons of capsules to sort and collect cute toy balls. Sort like you're on the ball!

apps.name: Sort the Tapes! Demo
apps.short_description: Sort the Tapes! Demo — уютная игра о сортировке VHS-кассет в американском видеопрокате начала 2000-х. Изучай обложки, ищи подсказки на видеомагнитофоне, принимай возвраты от клиентов и наведи порядок, прежде чем Рэй отправится в отпуск!

apps.name: Space Gnomes Demo
apps.short_description: Space Gnomes is a wacky multiplayer co-op game where a team of space gnomes is trying to escape an invading empire of space-faring garden moles focused on enslaving the known universe.

apps.name: Spaceborn Awakening Demo
apps.short_description: Spaceborn: Awakening is a narrative-driven roguelite bullet-heaven where you step into the role of a legendary space crew, answering a mysterious distress signal. Eliminate hordes of the Voss Praetor’s corrupted army, awaken your true potential, become a Spaceborn - decide the fate of the universe.

apps.name: Spellogger Demo
apps.short_description:
A slow-paced, cozy fantasy RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack.

Take on daily tasks and upgrade your character in a relaxing work cycle similar to Stardew Valley, while setting out on Elder Scrolls-style quests and exploration.

apps.name: Spin Realm: The Sovereign's Doom Demo
apps.short_description: An exploration roguelite where everything is decided on a wheel. Chase gear that bends your luck, take the fights you think you can win, and end the Sovereign's tyranny. Die and the city takes you back. Play alone or with friends.

apps.name: Squimo Demo
apps.short_description: The Squimo have taken over this planet. Grab your weapons, fight your way through endless hordes of Squimo, and face the Squimo King to reclaim the planet!

apps.name: Starliners Demo
apps.short_description: Build your first interplanetary civilization. Gather resources, establish colonies, connect your worlds, and develop the technologies needed to expand humanity across the Solar System.

apps.name: STATO Demo
apps.short_description: Shape a nation in a procedural grand strategy sandbox where geography, industry, diplomacy, and war drive emergent history. Build your state, secure resources, manage instability, and survive a world of rival powers.

apps.name: Steel Maiden Demo
apps.short_description: Two buttons. Pure, explosive speed. A lightning-fast action roguelite you play with just two buttons. Forge your own combat style with builds that shift every run, and chase that rush of pure dopamine through gorgeous, fluid visuals.

apps.name: Store Life Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Store Life Simulator (Demo) offers a limited experience! Manage a small grocery store, hire employees, handle stock, and serve customers while facing challenges. Ready to start?

apps.name: Stories Terminal Demo
apps.short_description: Stories Terminal is a detective text adventure inspired by classic parser games. Type your own commands, explore pixel-art locations, collect evidence, and solve a murder case on a midnight university campus.

apps.name: Submind Demo
apps.short_description: Dive into broken minds, with up to 3 friends, in order to stabilize them. Pick the correct path, solve puzzles, pay attention to your surroundings, all while making sure the patient's mind doesn't go to the point of no return, because if does, you'll be facing their worse traumas and nightmares.

apps.name: Super Cloud Fight Demo
apps.short_description: Super Cloud Fight allows you to experience a unique way of aerial combat with customizable planes, special combat maneuvers, and powerup$. This demo lets you battle against AI pilots, while the full game expands the experience with friends and competitors.

apps.name: Surfpunk Demo
apps.short_description: Surfpunk Demo is a 1-4 player co-op ARPG featuring radical surfer-pirates, procedurally-generated islands, awesome loot and endless swarms of monsters. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

apps.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build Demo
apps.short_description: Survive the dangerous swamp on a floating raft. Gather resources, craft tools, catch fish, purify water, expand your shelter, and defend yourself from hungry crocodiles lurking beneath the surface.

apps.name: Swordeye Demo
apps.short_description: Persistent PvPvE dungeons. Full loot extraction. 120 tick duel servers. 6-directional blocks and attacks. Master your sword or die trying. The demo includes 2 of the 4 Tower Dungeons and a large open world.

apps.name: Tabletop TD Demo
apps.short_description: A random tower defense around a tavern table, where everyone guards their own board. Draw towers with gold, from Spearman to Railgun, and set them by hand beside the rail. Merge three of a kind to grow stronger; it never fails. One lucky draw can turn the board around. Hold out solo or with friends.

apps.name: TALAKA Demo
apps.short_description: Slash, shoot, and restore myths and beasts in fluid, fast roguelite combat through a stunning hand-drawn watercolor world, where legends and even Orishas are going rogue in fear of being forgotten.

apps.name: Tanuki Tag Demo
apps.short_description: Play the Tanuki Tag Demo! This ain't your grandma's hide-and-seek! Stretch, squash, and shape yourself into ridiculous disguises. Go tiny, go HUGE, blend into your surroundings, and cause absolute chaos with your friends!

apps.name: Taverntasia Demo
apps.short_description: Bir büyücü olarak kendi tavernanı yönet! Çeşitli ırklardan misafirleri ağırla. İksirler ve otlarla sihirli içecekler demle, lezzetli yemekler sun. Hızlı ve kaliteli hizmetle müşterilerini mutlu et. İtibarını inşa et, para kazan ve tavernanı zirveye taşı!

apps.name: Teach my little sister how to drive Demo
apps.short_description: Your sister's first driving lesson! If you fail to teach her properly as an older brother, your survival cannot be guaranteed. Will you be able to survive safely until the end?

apps.name: Tenebris Legion Demo
apps.short_description: Day 1 of Tenebris Legion. In 1988, FBI trainee Ethan Nolan reaches his father's remote New England house and meets Laura Bennett, the woman his father married. Play the opening hours of an adult visual novel of mystery, temptation and supernatural dread, where every choice counts.

apps.name: Thank You For Your Application Demo
apps.short_description: Thank you for your application. After 15 rounds of interviews, you do not match our requirements for the position. You are transferred as a Junior Interviewer to review the candidate's resume according to the company's requirements and send appropriate thanks letters.

apps.name: THE FATUM Demo

apps.name: DayZ Badlands
apps.short_description: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

apps.name: Electrician Simulator - Smart Devices
apps.short_description: Electrician Simulator goes Smart! Complete new "wireless" missions and take your service to the next level. Fix plenty of new smart devices that needs repair and satisfy your clients!

apps.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Iceland
apps.short_description: Explore the Land of Fire and Ice! Iceland stands apart as one of the most extraordinary countries on Earth, an incredibly unique landscape with completely unmatched rugged nature. Now, you have the chance to experience it all from a truly unique perspective - behind the wheel of your truck.

apps.name: Europa Universalis V: Fate of the Phoenix
apps.short_description: Relive or revive the fading glories of the Eastern Roman Empire in Fate of the Phoenix, an Immersion Pack for Europa Universalis V. This DLC adds new historical flavor and content to the Byzantine Empire, with unique mechanics, historical options and alternative historical paths to pursue.

apps.name: Foundation: Harvest Festival
apps.short_description: Master the land by raising livestock, planting lush orchards, and cultivating hardy new crops. Expand your production chains to create new resources and crown your success by hosting the grandest of Harvest Festivals.

apps.name: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends (Unlock)
apps.short_description: Play the cooperative multiplayer experience inspired by Japanese folk tales and mythology.Choose from four classes – Samurai, Hunter, Ronin or Assassin – and play with friends or via online matchmaking in two-player story missions, four-player survival missions or Rivals Mode.

apps.name: Guild Wars 2® Janthir Wilds™ Expansion
apps.short_description: Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds™ is the fifth Guild Wars 2 expansion. Begin a risky expedition in search of support in the treacherous Janthir wilds, where hidden secrets and malevolent creatures lie in wait for your arrival.

apps.name: Gunsmith Simulator - Fabryka Broni Radom
apps.short_description: Fabryka Broni Radom – Polish Quality and Tradition in Gunsmith Simulator! Discover four legendary firearm models – the modern MSBS GROT, the iconic VIS wz. 35, the battle-proven Beryl wz. 96, and the compact Mini Beryl. Repair, explore history, and feel the passion for Polish engineering!

apps.name: Gunsmith Simulator - Flint & Powder
apps.short_description: Discover the secrets of historical firearms masters in the "Gunsmith Simulator - Flint & Powder" DLC! Repair, reconstruct, and test five unique models of historical flintlock weapons. Experience the craftsmanship of old gunsmiths and the history captured in iron and wood!

apps.name: Gunsmith Simulator - Heavy Metal DLC
apps.short_description: Heavy Metal DLC is a tribute to weapons that don’t do subtle - they just roar. This add-on brings four machine guns to Gunsmith Simulator: MG3, M60, PKP Pecheneg, and M249.

apps.name: Hunt: Showdown - The Trick Shooter
apps.short_description: This DLC contains one Hunter, two Weapons, and one Avatar:Carter (Hunter), Bear's Leg (Vandal 73C Bullseye), Carter's Quickshot (Specter 1882 Shorty), Carter (Avatar)

apps.name: I Am Your Beast - Quitting Time DLC
apps.short_description: Remember: you're one of the good guys. Fight a shadow war in Southeast Asia in this story prequel DLC to indie hit I Am Your Beast.

apps.name: Icarus: Dangerous Horizons Expansion
apps.short_description: DANGEROUS HORIZONS opens access to Elysium, a hazardous new map warped by radiation and exotic fallout. Discover Eden, tame new mounts, survive 30+ new species, and dive deeper into six chained narrative missions. Push yourself further with the arrival of Tier 5 tech, oil drilling and advanced gear.

apps.name: ICBM: Escalation - Assassin's Mace
apps.short_description: Rise from the ashes of civil war and transform China into a global superpower. Leverage asymmetric warfare, revolutionary doctrine and the Assassin's Mace strategy to overcome stronger rivals and reshape the balance of power.

apps.name: KAISERPUNK - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Support Kaiserpunk and enhance your experience with a variety of exclusive visual additions! This DLC offers a collection of unique cosmetic enhancements that personalize your game without altering gameplay.

apps.name: Machick 2 - Journey East
apps.short_description: Machick 2: Journey East brings Wuchick's journey through Chinese mythology, facing a wide variety of enemies and bosses. 4 Maps to explore, 4 Bosses and Mini-Bosses, 8 Enemies, 30 Accessories with unique functions, 10 Thematic Chickens with unique passive abilities.

apps.name: MISSING PLAY - Missing Texture
apps.short_description: Asymmetric multiplayer game in which players must complete objectives and escape whilst another player chases them and tries to eliminate them.

apps.name: Mr. Prepper - Animal Farm DLC
apps.short_description: Take care of the animals, repair the farm’s facilities, learn fishing, explore the new areas, adopt a dog, get to the bottom of the Agency’s special interest in the farm and discover the mystery lurking from above! Use what you learn on the farm in your shelter and breed your own animals!

apps.name: Mr. Prepper - Mountaineer DLC
apps.short_description: A cold new adventure awaits! Climb 10 levels of a mysterious mountain, survive freezing temperatures, uncover Agency secrets, and follow a mysterious climber's messages through a one-way walkie-talkie. Bring new technology and useful equipment back to your bunker.

apps.name: Mr. Prepper - Uranium Project DLC
apps.short_description: Gain access to a long-abandoned nuclear power plant, manage unstable uranium to craft powerful tools and weapons, advance through a new storyline, and decorate your bunker in a whole new way!

apps.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Bubble Pop Star
apps.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Bubble Pop Star style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

apps.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Cotton Candy Funfair
apps.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Cotton Candy Funfair style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

apps.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Dreamland Pajamas
apps.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Dreamland Pajamas style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

apps.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Flower Garden Fairy
apps.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Flower Garden Fairy style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

apps.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Ice Kingdom
apps.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Ice Kingdom style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

apps.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Space Explorer
apps.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Space Explorer style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

apps.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Squishy Bunny
apps.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Squishy Bunny style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

apps.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Undersea Fairy
apps.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Undersea Fairy style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

apps.name: Prince of Suburbia - Knock Me Up Again!
apps.short_description: In the "Knock Me Up Again!" DLC, escape to a desert oasis with a harem of BOOBalicious beauties in skimpy outfits, ready to turn your vacation into a lust-filled breeding frenzy. No longer pregnant and hornier than ever before, they have one shameless demand: "Knock Me Up Again!"

apps.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Everhood - "Powers of Destruction"
apps.short_description: Try your hand at the official Rhythm Rift for "Powers of Destruction" by Cazok (free song!) This track is part of the Everhood Music Pack.

apps.name: Sani Yang's Laboratory - Secret Plus
apps.short_description: Expand the narrative with new revelations in Sani Yang’s Laboratory, an additional detail that sheds light on the mysteries.

apps.name: Sentinels of the Multiverse - Rook City
apps.short_description: Dark streets, vile sewers, and twisting alleys; all home to the terrible criminals that control this city. Welcome to Rook City, where evil never sleeps. Includes Expatriette, Mr. Fixer, The Chairman, The Matriarch, Plague Rat, Spite, Pike Industrial Complex, and Rook City.

apps.name: Soulmask - Bone Bash
apps.short_description: Welcome to the fiesta of Bone Bash – yes, you're dead, but that's not the end. You and your tribesmen have simply taken on a far more entertaining form!

apps.name: Street Fighter™ 6 - Year 4 Ultimate Pass
apps.short_description:
Year 4 Ultimate Pass
- 4 additional characters
- 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10
- 4 additional characters' costume: Outfit 2 (including colors 1-10)
- 4 additional characters' costume: Outfit 3 (including colors 1-10)
- Bonus: 5,800 Drive Tickets

apps.name: SVFI - Professional
apps.short_description: SVFI Professional Version: super resolution modules, more exclusive VFI models, HDR content processing module and fine-grained output settings.

apps.name: TerraScape Ancient Egypt
apps.short_description: Expand your kingdom-building adventure in TerraScape Ancient Egypt! Master the sands by crafting irrigation systems to nourish the land, then raise mighty monuments under the desert sun. Discover new resources and mechanics as you lead your settlement to pharaonic glory. Will your legacy endure?

apps.name: THE FINALS - Bog Standard Set
apps.short_description:
The Bog Standard Set includes:
1 Legendary Outfit,
1 Legendary Weapon Skin,
1 Legendary Emote,
1 Rare Charm,
2 400 Multibucks.

apps.name: THE FINALS - Dead Certain Set
apps.short_description:
The Dead Certain Set includes:

1 Legendary Weapon Skin,

1 Mythic Emote,
