1 Epic Player Card Background,

6 250 Multibucks.

apps.name: THE FINALS - Season 12 Starter Pack
apps.short_description:
The Season 12 Starter Pack bundle includes:

- 3 Legendary Weapon Skins
- 1 Epic Season 12 Sticker
- 1 150 Multibucks.

apps.name: THE FINALS - Season 12 Ultimate Battle Pass Bundle
apps.short_description:
The Season 12 Ultimate Battle Pass includes:



- Season 12 Premium Battle Pass

- 20 Battle Pass Levels*

- 25% Match XP Boost

- 1,000 Multibucks

- Season 12 Ultimate Rewards in the Battle Pass



25% Match XP Boost will be applied to your Contestant for the duration of Season 12.

apps.name: Tom the Postgirl - Artbook
apps.short_description:
This artbook explores the creation of the world of Tom the Postgirl and its inhabitants.
Dive into the heart of Tom's world, from the first sketches to the final in-game illustrations!

apps.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Boris Todbringer – Lords of the End Times
apps.short_description: Command Boris Todbringer, Elector Count of Middenland in Total War: WARHAMMER III. Beloved by the wolf-god Ulric, Boris seeks to defend the Empire from destruction, and slay his nemesis, the Beastlord Khazrak One-Eye.

apps.name: Train Simulator: European Loco & Asset Pack
apps.short_description: The European Community Asset Pack is aimed at users creating and using independently developed content.

apps.name: UBAI 0
apps.short_description: Follow Gen's story as he recounts the founding of Ubai. Discover the tale that led to the organization's creation as Gen reveals their origins.

apps.name: Void Invaders - Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The Void Invaders OST is here! The soundtrack features music by .

apps.name: We Were Here Tomorrow: Fan Edition
apps.short_description: The Tomorrow Fan Edition contains exclusive content for our most dedicated Explorers. Discover the art and music of We Were Here Tomorrow with the Digital Art Book, official soundtrack and exclusive wallpapers.

apps.name: Electronics Repair Shop
apps.short_description: Open your own electronics repair shop! Take devices apart, diagnose faults, and replace broken components. Buy and sell used electronics, invest your earnings in new equipment, and grow your small shop.

apps.name: .curator
apps.short_description: In a world imagined by acclaimed SF writer Richard K. Morgan, you are The .Curator. Use C.R.I.S.S.I. to glimpse the future — and rewrite it! In this episode-based detective adventure, choose your path, decide who lives or dies, and turn enemies into stepping stones toward saving the world.

apps.name: 4 Penny Coffins
apps.short_description: In 4 Penny Coffins, up to 8 players hunt a hidden murderer through lies, shifting alibis, and hard evidence in our online multiplayer mode. This social investigation game also includes a solo mode for those brave enough to face the fog alone.

apps.name: 4:LOOP
apps.short_description:
It’s just you and your crew versus an alien invasion. Odds are you’re going to die. A lot. 

Thankfully, that’s all part of The Plan.

apps.name: 72 Seconds
apps.short_description: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

apps.name: 8 More Lives
apps.short_description: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Lead a mercenary company of outcast cats through a gritty procedural open world. Take contracts, count coin, bury the dead. Battle rival warbands and night horrors. You have 8 more lives - try not to waste them all.

apps.name: A Night at Ashmere Manor
apps.short_description: When your father goes missing with little more than a letter to clue you in, it's up to you to find him. His last known whereabouts? Ashmere Manor. Will you succeed in solving the mystery at the heart of the house and find your father, or will you succumb to its phantom call?

apps.name: A Rat's Quest - The Way Back Home | Season 2
apps.short_description: Stranded far from home, Mat, the determined young rat, must brave the dangerous "Outside" to make his way back to his friends and Nat. Armed with only a rivet, he must face new foes and forge alliances in order to complete his epic quest and be reunited with his beloved.

apps.name: A Sector Darkly
apps.short_description: Experience an epic story in this open-world space exploration rpg. Stranded far from home in a region torn apart by war, you must scavenge, research, and craft what you need to survive as you chart a course through dangerous sectors, uncover rival alien agendas, and search for a way home.

apps.name: A Sister's Journey
apps.short_description: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

apps.name: Abandon All Hope
apps.short_description: Abandon All Hope is a 1 to 4 player dark fantasy action RPG. Hunt the Seven Sins across a shattering world, master tactical combat, and craft absurdly powerful gear. Mix Weapons with different classes, play your way combat. 5+ Ways to earn loot after the campaign. Can you survive the decent?

apps.name: Abashed
apps.short_description: Abashed lets you step into the troubled mind of Issac, as the fragments of his past flash before his eyes. Solve puzzles, meet mysterious characters, and alter reality as he faces his worst fears to uncover the truth behind his missing partner, or so he thought.

apps.name: Ablahshikar
apps.short_description: Ablahshikar is a turn-based ASCII salvage-survival game adrift on the Candle Sea. Bound to a worn terminal of bone-white and brass, you must strip wrecks and tear organs direct from rival vessels. Graft severed parts onto your keel to rebuild a failing warship into a doomed chimera.

apps.name: Abraxas Online
apps.short_description: Build a lasting hero in a classic fantasy MMORPG. Explore a persistent world, fight in real time, compete in PvP, master nine professions, craft, and trade with other players.

apps.name: Acid Knife
apps.short_description: Combat like 2D Mario found a knife and fell into a Souls game.  Built around "Action Crafting" where chopping trees, mining resources, cooking and creating items is all done through action mechanics, not menus.

apps.name: Acornia: Mirror Worlds
apps.short_description: Acornia: Mirror Worlds is a bake-and-brawl management adventure game! Run your shop in one dimension, fight angry spirits in the other. Your special skill? Stuffing your bottomless cheek pouches with treats - to plate up or shoot up enemies!

apps.name: Act Normal
apps.short_description: Act Normal is a multiplayer game where you blend in as an NPC and steal enough to survive each round. With scores hidden, you never know if you're safe. Every player carries a hidden gun. Find them before they find you.

apps.name: Acts of Blood
apps.short_description: Master the art of hand-to-hand combat in Acts of Blood, a gritty and fast-paced third-person brawler with brutal combo chains and blood-soaked revenge.

apps.name: After Green
apps.short_description: Stack upgrades and forge relic-and-tower synergies as cute zombie hordes closing in. Dash, shoot and build defenses in this horde-survival roguelite as you choose your road to the Horde King, solo or in co-op. Fall, and your Last Wish powers the next run back to the floor that killed you!

apps.name: AFTERZERO - The Last Drive
apps.short_description: Drive and survive through a frozen post-industrial wasteland. Gear up your vehicle with different tools to tackle hostile threats, while scavenging for resources. Lead a small survivor camp while discovering the truth about what happened.

apps.name: Age Twisters
apps.short_description: Age Twisters is a 2-player co-op narrative adventure game that allows you to send a free invite to friends via the Friend’s Pass. Play as a grandfather and granddaughter to solve puzzles by freely changing your age and reveal the dark secrets hidden beneath a facade of lies.

apps.name: AI Office Idle: Night Shift
apps.short_description: Run an office of parody AI models through the night. Work jobs by hand, buy models like Llamba and Clawed into desks, and keep them cool with fans, a battery and solar panels. Pivot for Vision, open five offices on a city map and take the company public.

apps.name: Airport Contraband
apps.short_description: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

apps.name: Airport Police Contraband Simulator - Border Patrol
apps.short_description: Inspect passengers, scan luggage, interrogate suspects, and uncover hidden contraband at an international airport. Use X-rays, metal detectors, and police dogs to stop smuggling and rise through the ranks in Airport Contraband Police.

apps.name: Airship 2: Kingdoms Ablaze
apps.short_description: Command fleets in tactical aerial battles, build trade and industrial networks, and shape diplomacy in this skypunk action simulation strategy game where rival powers clash for control of the skies.

apps.name: Alchemist: Infinite Corridor
apps.short_description: Run a cozy alchemy shop at the mouth of an endless dungeon. Sell potions to adventurers, secretly raise monsters in your cellar and release them below. Pay the corridor its toll in gold, earn wisdom, and descend - until it devours you, or you rule it as the Grand Alchemist.

apps.name: Alchemortis
apps.short_description:
Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies.
Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

apps.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid
apps.short_description: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.

apps.name: ALTEREDBLOOD+
apps.short_description: A BLOOD-soaking Movement-FPS platformer🩸where you Splatter walls and floors with your foe’s BLOOD. Stand in that BLOOD to [ALTER] yourself and your Weapons. Soak up BLOOD to replenish and keep fighting. MOTHER created you to stop them. Beckon our Extinction.

apps.name: Amusement Factory
apps.short_description: Build the theme park of your dreams. Lay the roads, place the rides, open the shops and keep every guest smiling from the gate to the last bus home. A bright, cozy park builder with a ten-location campaign, free play with no limits, and a front-seat view of every ride you put down.

apps.name: Andromeda Wars
apps.short_description: Andromeda Wars is a retro styled space RTS. In Andromeda Wars you must gather power, build a fleet, build defences to defend your mothership, and try to survive the onslaught from the opposing factions. Each ship you add to your fleet gives you powers but also reduces your dwindling resources.

apps.name: Anicards
apps.short_description: Balanced 4-player card strategy with 25-minute matches. No Pay-to-Win. No Powercreep. Skill over Random.

apps.name: Anthology of Fear: Prologue
apps.short_description: Anthology of Fear is the first-person psychological horror, focusing on the story and solving the secrets of the game world. Discover the beginning of the first of three completely unique dark stories in this climatic prologue.

apps.name: Antillia
apps.short_description: Rebuild a fallen seafaring family in this single-player exploration RPG set in the 15th century. Read winds and currents, follow rumors to discoveries, and fund expeditions through trade and patronage. Face naval battles and duels as you write a family chronicle across generations.

apps.name: ApesCape
apps.short_description: In a deep-sea station lost at the bottom of the ocean, the pressure is rising and water is flooding the facility. In this cooperative FPS, every second counts. Work together to find the exit before everything is swallowed by the depths.

apps.name: ApocalypseHQ
apps.short_description: Lead a survivor headquarters after the zombie outbreak in this turn-based management strategy game, where each turn represents one day. Allocate scarce people and supplies, restore territories and infrastructure, and expand through research and high-risk external operations.

apps.name: Apple Crumble
apps.short_description: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

apps.name: Apples Everywhere! Let's Tidy Up
apps.short_description: The orchard is overflowing, and there are Apples Everywhere! Clean up the grounds in this cozy Tidy-Up-lite, a tidy-up game with only two item types: good apples for the market crate, wormy ones for the food bin. Earn money, buy powerful upgrades, and unlock animal helpers. Let's tidy up!

apps.name: Approaching Infinity: Survivors
apps.short_description: A sci-fi Bullet-Heaven survivors-like in the rich Approaching Infinity universe. Fight increasingly difficult battles both in space and on the ground. Level up fast! Unlock new ships, captains, and weapons. Decide the fate of the galaxy! (Made for humans, by humans, but aliens would be welcome.)

apps.name: Aqua Factory Simulator
apps.short_description: Harvest and farm aquatic commodities, build and automate your factory, and turn the commodities into valuable products. Run the store automatically, expand your operation, optimize your production, and team up with friends in co-op to build and manage your growing aquatic business.

apps.name: Aquanaut
apps.short_description: Delve into the depths of an accursed ocean in this top-down bullet hell roguelike. Battle impossible odds, amass hoards of treasure, and become incredibly powerful - or drown trying.

apps.name: Arcade Lacrosse
apps.short_description:
Top-down arcade box lacrosse inspired by an all-time childhood favorite. Pick skinny, medium, or heavy body types - each with radically different speed, power, and checking.  Versus, Co-Op, Multiplayer.  Global leaderboard.

 GET IN EARLY. 

Lowest price during inaugural version.

apps.name: Arcane Revolt
apps.short_description: Arcane Revolt is an action role-playing game with pixel graphics. Lead a revolution as a powerful mage against tyrants in a fantasy medieval world. Customize your spells and make decisions that will benefit your cause in battle. Improve your spells, start the rebellion, and bring down the order!

apps.name: Arcforge
apps.short_description: Arcforge is a co-op Action RPG built around fast-paced magical combat. Master different schools of magic, combine abilities, explore a dangerous world, collect powerful loot, and fight hordes of enemies and mighty bosses with your friends.

apps.name: Archival Security
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game about a transcription job that goes wrong very slowly. Copy the projected slides, word for word. Follow the rules. Do not respond if the text asks you a question. ACCURACY IS OUR HIGHEST PRIORITY.

apps.name: Arctic Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

apps.name: ARES: THE IRON VANGUARD
apps.short_description:
▣ Stylish Sci-Fi Action RPG ▣
■ Switch combat suits and classes in real time.
■ Master parries, perfect dodges, and powerful combos.
■ Battle massive enemies across vast battlefields with other Guardians.

apps.name: Artifact Tracer
apps.short_description: Every artifact is a mystery left by history. Artifact Tracer is a visual deduction game about Chinese artifacts. Study shapes, patterns, and craftsmanship, trace their origins on a map and timeline, challenge 1,000+ real artifacts, unlock archives, and compete in daily rankings.

apps.name: Artificial Detective
apps.short_description: Artificial Detective is an action-adventure where you step into the shoes of a robodetective in a dystopian city overrun by rogue robots. Lead your underdog team of a military robodog and a human girl as you fight, hack, and outsmart your enemies to uncover why humans are gone.

apps.name: ASCII Dungeon Crawl
apps.short_description: A party-based roguelite dungeon crawler drawn in ASCII. Turn-based combat, permadeath, and over a hundred passives to unlock across runs. Push through two full dungeons with your own party of heroes. Every run ends. Every unlock stays.

apps.name: Ashen Marches
apps.short_description: Ashen Marches is a turn-based tactics RPG played like a tabletop campaign. Roll the dice, parry the blows you see coming, and lead two heroes to the Dragon Cave, alone or with a friend in online co-op.

apps.name: Ashes of the Singularity II
apps.short_description: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.

apps.name: Astralight: Pilgrim's Duel
apps.short_description: A fantasy card game where a deck-building roguelike meets a TCG. Draft a deck, explore branching dungeon maps, collect relics and defeat hero bosses, or build your collection and duel with a 30-card deck.

apps.name: Astro beasts
apps.short_description: Astro Beasts is a co-op roguelite arena shooter where every hero has unique abilities! Upgrade your weapons, build defenses, deploy turrets and mines, create crazy combinations, and survive alongside your friends!

apps.name: At Fate's End
apps.short_description: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

apps.name: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
apps.short_description: Atelier Karia tells the story of Karia, who has no memories, as she faces her past. New features add to the strategy of battles and depth of alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

apps.name: AUROK
apps.short_description: Free-to-play action arena and co-op campaign. Pick Warrior, Archer, Mage or Barbarian, summon beasts that fight at your side, build a clan and brawl in 12-player free-for-all, 6v6 teams and Titan War. 10 co-op stages with bosses. macOS, Windows and Linux.

apps.name: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
apps.short_description: Experience daily police duty on Germany's Autobahn like never before and keep the peace in a living open world. From traffic stops to high-speed pursuits: every call is yours to answer.

apps.name: AUTOMATE DEATH
apps.short_description: AUTOMATE DEATH in this physically simulated incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.

apps.name: Autosaurs: Hyper Dino Battler
apps.short_description: Bolt experimental Parts onto robot dinosaurs, chain their statuses into game-breaking synergies, and merge your squad into evolved monsters. A single-player auto-battler roguelike where every run crafts a new team and a new gauntlet to the boss.

apps.name: Avenues & Acres
apps.short_description: A top-down city builder that combines detailed road construction, interconnected economic systems and the everyday lives of individual residents. Design your city from the ground up, manage the services that keep it running, and discover the stories unfolding behind its streets and rooftops.

apps.name: BACKROOMS: REALITY FAILURE
apps.short_description: BACKROOMS: REALITY FAILURE is a first-person psychological horror game where your first day at work becomes a nightmare. Explore a distorted office complex, uncover mysterious letters, and find a way out as reality begins to fall apart around you.

apps.name: BackStreet
apps.short_description: BackStreet is a 3D action roguelite game that combines dynamic combo-based combat with deep strategic elements, all with simple controls. Stand against the tyranny of the corrupted city management AI, 3COS, in a world abandoned by humans due to environmental devastation.

apps.name: Bad Goons
apps.short_description:
Blast through cover, carve trenches, and build massive fortifications to dominate the battlefield.
Adapt to ever-changing environments and discover new tactics with every match.
Outsmart your enemies with pure War-IQ.
No more gooning around! It’s time to join the fight.

apps.name: Bad Grip Club
apps.short_description: Bad Grip Club is a physics-based co-op climbing game where you grab ledges, pull friends up cliffs, use ridiculous items, and survive four cartoonish biomes. Play on PC or in VR, team up with friends across platforms, and enjoy the chaos together!

apps.name: Ballistic.exe
apps.short_description: A despicably detailed shooting simulator wrapped in a declassified computer program. Dozens of weapons, 200+ cartridges, 1000+ attachments, and absolutely nothing supernatural.

apps.name: Ballseye
apps.short_description: A Goofy 2D Nubby-like featuring Monsters, Shooting, Explosions. There are a total of 8 different areas and their contents are procedurally generated each time they are played. The game can be played Solo, but it also supports Multiplayer PVP, Co-op, Level building and sharing.

apps.name: Band of Fortune
apps.short_description: Lead a band of fortune born from the roll of the dice. Every saga brings a new frontier region on a hex map and three threats to break. Trade, gear up and fight hard turn-based battles where every roll counts and the fallen never come back.

apps.name: Battle Nap
apps.short_description: Battle Nap is a roguelite top-down shooter where your picnic nap becomes an explosive journey into dreamland domination. Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done. Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

apps.name: Battleship Blitz
apps.short_description: A modern take on the classic Battleship game - now in 3D! Place your wooden fleet, take aim, and sink enemy ships in singleplayer or PvP multiplayer. Simple, nostalgic, and addictive.

apps.name: BattleSpinners
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, spinning-tops versus game. Build your spinner, launch it into the arena, and defeat your opponents by knocking them out of the ring, or by tearing them apart. Brawl against or alongside your friends, use your skills and unleash powerful abilities to dominate the arena (1-4 players)

apps.name: Bay 23
apps.short_description: You're an expendable robot on the night shift. Haul packages through a procedurally generated warehouse, dodge a hunting AI and roaming sentinels, and get out before your battery dies. Co-op scavenger horror with full physics-based hauling.

apps.name: Beach Bar Simulator
apps.short_description: Build your own paradise on the Miami coast! Run a beach bar solo or with up to 6 friends in co-op. Expand your pier freely, master realistic mixology, and keep rowdy crowds under control. In this sun-drenched simulator, every drink you mix shapes your success.

apps.name: Beach Volleyball VR
apps.short_description: Beach Volleyball VR brings 2v2 beach volleyball to virtual reality. Pass, set, spike, serve and block using natural VR movements, play complete matches against bots, or jump online and play with friends.

apps.name: Beards & Blades
apps.short_description: Run a dwarven smithy at the mouth of a dungeon. Heat, hammer, quench and sharpen gear by hand for the frog knights, boar barbarians and other odd heroes heading below, then wait at the counter to see who comes back. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 smiths.

apps.name: Beat For Speed
apps.short_description: Turn any song into a playable rhythm ride! Import your favorite music or play along with your device's audio in Live Audio Mode. Discover official tracks from indie artists, climb the leaderboards, create custom levels in the Level Editor, and explore endless community levels on Steam Workshop.

apps.name: Bedtime Battalion
apps.short_description: When the house falls asleep, the toys go to war! Command wobbly toy soldiers across a child's bedroom and six ages of history, from cavemen to tanks, in physics battles where a vacuum cleaner, a giant ball or the lights going out can turn any fight.

apps.name: Beware of the Cartographer!
apps.short_description: Map a mysterious land during the Age of Enlightenment. Draw the border between two warring kingdoms. Meet the locals. Juggle their demands with the requirements of your mission. Ethical dilemmas, secret plots, strange phenomena… will you be able to bring peace back to the land?

apps.name: Black Stars - The M87 Conflict
apps.short_description: Command a rising interstellar empire in the M87 cluster. Explore and colonize distant worlds, build powerful economies, terraform hostile planets, deploy specialized fleets, and wage war against rival factions in a VR-exclusive galactic 4X strategy game where every decision shapes the conflict.

apps.name: Blackout Route
apps.short_description: The world has been taken over by the Synchronization Network. A co-op action horror game with crafting, raids, and extraction. Defend your base, rescue survivors, gather resources, fight Network Agents, disable Signals, and make it back to camp alive.

apps.name: BlackOut!
apps.short_description: How long can you brain survive the Black Out!

apps.name: Blind Katana: The Ember Keeper
apps.short_description: Samurai action roguelike as a blind swordsman who sees by sound. In the [Eternal Night], enemy footsteps become waves of light that reveal them. Read the dark, slash, guard, roll and execute foes. Pick a card each stage to build your swordplay, and face the [Darkest Hour], who stole the [Ember].

apps.name: Block King Demands Red Squares
apps.short_description:
Automate a network of towns producing the required shapes for the ever fickle Block King while keeping the citizens happy.
Remember, if you fail, you will get fired.

apps.name: Blockade Run
apps.short_description: A single player side scrolling arcade shooter. Guide your ship through 16 levels of increasing mayhem and face off against 20 enemy types and 16 unique bosses.  Use quicksilver reactions, or thoughtful planning to get through obstacles and opponents.

apps.name: Bloodlines & Banners
apps.short_description: A historical 4X where you rule a dynasty, not just an empire. 88 civilizations across ten eras of real history on a hex map of Earth. Your rulers age and die; the heir you raised inherits their traits, their rivalries, and your bloodline's standing.

apps.name: Bloomies
apps.short_description: A cozy incremental creature collector that lives on your taskbar! Plant seeds, hatch eggs and raise over 70 unique Bloomies while you work or play. Unlock skills until it all runs itself, defeat bosses for new seeds and hunt rare Sparkle variants to complete your collection.
